   - `_validate_trans_variables(variables, parser, lineno)`: Iterates over translation variables (both declared in block headers and referenced in translation bodies) to verify that variable names are valid Python identifiers and do not conflict with reserved translation function names (`gettext`, `ngettext`, `pgettext`, `npgettext`, `_`).
   - `_validate_trans_expression(name, expr, parser, lineno)`: Validates the AST node type of variable expressions. Allows literals (`nodes.Const`), variable references (`nodes.Name`), simple function calls (`nodes.Call` with a `nodes.Name` function), attribute access (`nodes.Getattr`), filters (`nodes.Filter`), and tests (`nodes.Test`). Rejects template data (`nodes.TemplateData`), output nodes (`nodes.Output`), nested call expressions, and complex/unsupported expressions.
